title: New content not showing, old content still playing
symptoms: content not updating, old menu showing, new content missing, schedule not working
body:
## Steps

1. Confirm the new playlist is assigned to the correct device or device group.
2. Check the schedule start and end dates and the site's time zone.
3. Confirm the player has synced since the change (last sync time in the console).
4. Trigger a manual sync from the console.

## Escalate if

Player has synced but still plays old content.

title: Screen flickers or shows lines
symptoms: flickering, lines on screen, flashing, distorted image
body:
## Steps

1. Check whether the flicker also appears on the display's own menu. If yes, the display is likely faulty.
2. If only content flickers, swap the HDMI cable.
3. Set the player output resolution to match the display's native resolution in the console.

## Escalate if

Flicker appears on the display's own menu, or continues after a cable swap and resolution change.

title: Display shows 'No signal'
symptoms: no signal, no input, blue screen with no signal message
body:
## Steps

1. Confirm the HDMI cable is firmly seated at both the player and the display.
2. Using the display remote, set the input to the port the player is connected to (many units default to HDMI 2).
3. Check the player is powered: status LED should be lit.
4. Swap in a known-good HDMI cable if one is on site.

## Escalate if

Still 'No signal' with a known-good cable and the correct input selected.

title: Content appears sideways or upside down
symptoms: content sideways, wrong orientation, rotated, upside down
body:
## Steps

1. Confirm whether the display is mounted in portrait or landscape.
2. In the console, set the device orientation to match the mounting.
3. Re-push the playlist so content re-renders.

## Escalate if

Orientation is correct in the console but content still renders rotated.

title: Video plays but there is no sound
symptoms: no audio, no sound, muted, video without sound
body:
## Steps

1. Check the display's volume and mute setting with the remote.
2. Confirm audio output is enabled for the device in the console.
3. Confirm the content file itself has an audio track.

## Escalate if

Sound is enabled everywhere and the file has audio, but nothing plays.

title: Black screen after a firmware update
symptoms: black screen, display on but no content, screen went black after update
body:
## Steps

1. Check the player's status LED. Blinking amber means the update is still installing: wait 15 minutes (updates on X1 firmware 4.2+ take longer).
2. If the LED is solid green, reboot the player from the management console. Content should appear within 3 minutes.
3. Confirm a playlist is assigned to the device in the console.
4. Re-push the current playlist.

## Escalate if

Still black after re-pushing the playlist, or the player shows offline for more than 30 minutes.

title: Player goes offline on a Wi-Fi site
symptoms: player offline, drops off network, disconnected, intermittent connection
body:
## Steps

1. Check in the console when the player was last seen online.
2. Ask the site whether the Wi-Fi network name or password changed recently.
3. Reboot the player from the console or have site staff power-cycle it.
4. If the network changed, update the Wi-Fi profile on the player from the console.

## Escalate if

Offline more than 2 hours after a power-cycle, or the site network is unchanged and the player still drops repeatedly.

title: Player reboots on its own or feels hot
symptoms: random reboots, overheating, player hot, restarts by itself
body:
## Steps

1. Check the console event log for repeated restart events.
2. Ask the site whether the player is enclosed or mounted behind the display without airflow.
3. Ask site staff to clear vents and allow at least 5 cm of clearance.
4. Check the player's reported temperature in the console if available.

## Escalate if

Restarts continue after airflow is fixed, or reported temperature stays above the safe limit.

title: Player storage full, new content fails to download
symptoms: storage full, download failed, not enough space, content failed to load
body:
## Steps

1. Check the player's free storage in the console.
2. Remove playlists no longer scheduled on that device.
3. Trigger a manual sync to download the new content.

## Escalate if

Storage still shows full after removing unused playlists.

title: Touchscreen not responding to taps
symptoms: touch not working, screen not responding, taps ignored, touchscreen frozen
body:
## Steps

1. Ask site staff to wipe the screen; moisture or grease blocks touch input.
2. Reboot the kiosk from the management console.
3. In the console, confirm the touch driver shows as connected.
4. Run the touch calibration from the kiosk's maintenance menu.

## Escalate if

Touch is still unresponsive after calibration, or the driver shows as disconnected.
